title: Changing the search or a filter clears the ticks but sorting keeps them
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TICKS-01 and -02) are active at {Location-A}, in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered).
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TICKS-03) is active, in category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered).
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TICKS); a longer search text {Prefix-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TICKS-0) still matches all three.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row.
  6. Click the {Part-B} row.
  7. Click the Description column header.
  8. Click the Description column header again.
  9. Change the Search text to {Prefix-B}.
  10. Click the {Part-A} row.
  11. Click the {Part-B} row.
  12. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-A}.
  13. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The bar reads "2 selected".
  • Steps 7 and 8: The order of the rows changes, and {Part-A} and {Part-B} stay ticked: the bar still reads "2 selected".
  • Step 9: {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} are still listed, but the ticks are cleared: no row is ticked and the bar reads "0 selected".
  • Step 11: The bar reads "2 selected" again.
  • Step 12: Only {Part-A} and {Part-B} are listed, and the ticks are cleared: the bar reads "0 selected".
  • Step 13: Bulk mode ends and no part changed status.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R10a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.3 (Two rows ticked), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R10a: “Changing the search term or a filter clears the ticks, so the user only ever changes parts they can see. Sorting keeps them.”
